review.posthog_relevance: Adds Copper warehouse ingestion support, including session management, pagination, endpoint configuration, and warehouse schema discovery.
review.reason: This chunk implements Copper warehouse ingestion support. P1.F3.H3 establishes the session and pagination helpers; P1.F4.H3 configures the Copper API endpoints; P1.F5.H2 adds tests for pagination and checkpointing; P1.F6.H1 updates warehouse schema discovery. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The implementation does not show the actual ingestion or warehouse-side processing, only the setup and configuration. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of the ingestion support, not the actual ingestion or warehouse-side processing.
